items.title: Nasdaq 100 Has Worst Week Since 2020 on AI Drama: Markets Wrap
items.content: Weeks of anxiety around the viability of the artificial-intelligence trade erupted into a full-blown selloff, pushing the S&P 500 to a technical correction while lifting bonds and haven currencies.

items.title: J&J Snack Foods CEO on 4Q Results and Consumer Sentiment
items.content: J&J Snack Foods CEO Dan Fachner said the company’s turnaround is on track after a strong year, citing Project Apollo’s more than $25 million in durable savings. A second phase, Apollo 2, is expected to generate another $5 million by 2027 through distribution and manufacturing improvements. Fachner speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: El Salvador Troops Killed in Haiti Blast After Rescue Deployment
items.content: Two Salvadoran soldiers died in Haiti after an explosion struck an area where they were working, weeks after President Nayib Bukele ordered a large deployment to the Caribbean island nation to find missing troops.

items.title: ‘Always Remain Liquid’: Richards
items.content: Bruce Richards, managing partner and head of CVC Marathon, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on “Bloomberg Money.” They discuss Richards’ favorite investing advice he has received throughout his career. items.title: Adjusting for Credit Risk: Masters In Business with David Eichhorn
items.content: Barry speaks with David Eichhorn, CEO and Head of Investment Strategies at NISA Investment Advisors. They discuss his early days as a quant at JPMorgan before returning home to St. Louis to work at NISA. They also discuss the risks and benefits of the private credit market, along with the dangers of private credit going into pension funds and 401Ks. They also discuss liability investment strategies for managing over $483 billion in client assets.  (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: CrowdStrike Said in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
items.content: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would be among the largest-ever in the cybersecurity sector. Zscaler, which had a market value of $32 billion at the end of regular trading Friday, rose about 16% after the close. The two companies are discussing a potential combination that could come together soon, the people said, asking not to be identified because the information is confidential. Bloomberg News Deals Reporter Ryan Gould reports on the deal.  (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Bayer’s $7.25 Billion Roundup Settlement Approved by Judge
items.content: A Missouri judge approved a Bayer AG proposal to contain its mounting legal costs by paying as much as $7.25 billion to resolve tens of thousands of US lawsuits by people who blame the company’s Roundup weedkiller for their cancers.

items.title: Anthropic IPO Could  Mark End of the AI Trade
items.content: Anna Wong, Bloomberg Economics Chief US Economist warns Anthropic’s slice of the token market has narrowed: and that the hyperscaler has surrendered a substantial part of its price premium without strengthening its competitive position. That’s a warning that enterprises may be moving workloads to cheaper models, weakening Anthropic’s pricing power. (Source: Bloomberg)
